B_e3.sample: KLOE charge-averaged inclusive Ke3, matched to K+ assuming no relevant CP difference

r_conversion.range_role: Declared broad matching range, not measured uncertainty. Common charged and rare normalization for local left vector amplitudes.

other_amplitude.role: Only an independent illustrative size cap on ALL contributions other than the tested tree source in a matched extension. Must rederive if CKM, loops or short-distance coefficients change.

working_ranges: Use two quoted widths for the numerical rare-rate upper/lower edge. Add both KLOE quoted widths linearly before stretching and use earlier 1381 |Vus| product/form ranges. Conservative rectangles allow correlation; no likelihood or joint confidence label. Compare against historical 1383 one-width charged-current box for a positive deficit.
neutrinos: Three active light neutrinos, universal left Z coupling, invisible final mass negligible, common vector distributions and corrected acceptances. Orthogonal species summed as probabilities.
